page_title: MAR 1-1 STR | Marseille v Strasbourg 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

90+7' The opposition back off Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli denies him with the save.
90+6' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' It must be a yellow card. It is. Lilian Brassier (Marseille) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robinio Vaz (Marseille) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+3' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

88' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Strasbourg will have a corner.
85' Luis Henrique (Marseille) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
83' Marseille fail to score from a corner as Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) leaps to collect the ball.
83' The ball is cleared after Robinio Vaz (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Marseille.

80' Ambitious effort from Robinio Vaz (Marseille). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
79' Luis Henrique (Marseille) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
77' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
76' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Sebastian Nanasi is replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
76' Dilane Bakwa comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
75' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Bastien Dechepy had a clear view and blows his whistle.
73' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
72' POST! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
71' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Pol Lirola (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
71' A corner kick by Marseille is thwarted by the well prepared Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg).

70' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
68' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mason Greenwood (Marseille) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic no chance!
68' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is going to take the penalty!

66' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for an infringement. PENALTY to Marseille! Let's see who will take responsibility.
64' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
64' Luis Henrique (Marseille) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
64' Marseille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

64' A lofted cross from Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Quentin Merlin (Marseille) replacing Ulisses Garcia.
61' Substitution. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) has come on for Bilal Nadir.
58' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
52' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
52' The referee points to the corner flag and Marseille will take a corner.
51' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Luis Henrique (Marseille) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
47' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
46' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Pol Lirola comes on in place of Derek Cornelius (Marseille).
46' Half-time substitution. Neal Maupay (Marseille) will not participate anymore and Robinio Vaz is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
42' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
42' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
40' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
38' CLOSE! Luis Henrique (Marseille) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
38' Marseille take a short corner kick.
38' Luis Henrique (Marseille) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
36' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
36' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) is about to take a corner kick.
34' Luis Henrique (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
31' Strasbourg fail to score from a corner as Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
31' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee signals a corner kick to Strasbourg.
28' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
26' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
23' 0 - 1 Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) struck from medium range. He buried the ball inside the right post.
20' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
19' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and it's Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
18' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
15' Luis Henrique (Marseille) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
14' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
11' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
11' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
9' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' A cross into the box from Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) is cleared.
6' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
4' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
